landing.headline: Skip the scroll. Take a seat.
landing.subline: Six strangers. Four weeks. One table, again and again.

closing_screen.message: That's everything for today. Your next letter arrives at 8:00 pm tomorrow. See you at the table.

checkin.intro: Three quick questions so we can look after everyone properly. This isn't a test, and we only keep a simple result, not your answers.

withdraw.confirmation: Thank you for giving it a try. We'll let your host know so they can check in with you kindly. Your letters will be hidden from the pod.
